page_title: BAR 1-0 ALA | Barcelona v Alaves 02/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.
90+1' Eduardo Coudet has decided to make a change. Asier Villalibre (Alaves) replaces Ander Guevara.
90+1' The substitution has been made. Pau Victor (Barcelona) has replaced Robert Lewandowski.
90+1' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) is caught offside!
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
89' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
89' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
88' Toni Martinez (Alaves) gets on the end of a cross but produces a tame shot from the edge of the area which goes well wide of the right post.
85' Ander Guevara (Alaves) makes a strong challenge and Jose Munuera blows for a foul.
83' The manager makes a subsitution with Gerard Martin (Barcelona) coming on for Alejandro Balde.
82' Let's have a look at the offside statistics – 2:11.
82' Flag up against Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
81' Jose Munuera couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Ander Guevara (Alaves) and blew his whistle.

81' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Jose Munuera with no other option than to blow for a foul.
80' The linesman raises his flag. Hugo Novoa Ramos (Alaves) is adjudged offside.
79' Manu Sanchez (Alaves) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
78' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Jose Munuera blows for a foul.
77' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Hugo Novoa Ramos (Alaves) heads on.
76' Here is a change. Carlos Vicente is going off and Eduardo Coudet gives the last tactical orders to Hugo Novoa Ramos (Alaves).
76' Substitution. Toni Martinez (Alaves) has come on for Jon Guridi.
76' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
76' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Ferran Torres (Barcelona).
74' A snap shot by Ferran Torres (Barcelona) from the edge of the area flies towards the right side of the goal, but Jesus Owono produces a good save to thwart him.
72' The linesman signals that Jon Guridi (Alaves) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
71' Kike Garcia (Alaves) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
67' Raphinha (Barcelona) gets a yellow card, off the field.
67' Hansi Flick has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ferran Torres (Barcelona) replacing Raphinha.
65' Having seen unsporting behavior, Jose Munuera shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Carlos Protesoni (Alaves) is the recipient.
65' Jon Guridi (Alaves) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Jose Munuera no option but to blow his whistle.
61' 1 - 0 Goal! Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the top of the net. It's 1:0.
61' Raphinha (Barcelona) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
61' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the roof of the net, but Jesus Owono thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
59' Moussa Diarra (Alaves) makes a rough challenge and Jose Munuera blows his whistle for a foul.
58' Carlos Martin (Alaves) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
57' What a chance that is! Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross, but he sends his header narrowly wide of the left post.
57' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Raphinha (Barcelona). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
55' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
55' Raphinha (Barcelona) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
53' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
50' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
46' The game is over for Marc Casado (Barcelona). Frenkie de Jong comes on for the second half.
46' Hansi Flick has made a change at the break. Eric Garcia has come on in place of Ronald Araujo (Barcelona).
46' Referee Jose Munuera blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+7' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' The offside statistics – 2:11.
45+5' Flag goes up against Kike Garcia (Alaves) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
45+4' A player from Barcelona commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
45+4' Raphinha (Barcelona) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
45+2' It looks like Ander Guevara (Alaves) saw red with that tackle. Jose Munuera won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
45' 6 additional min. will be played.
45' Raphinha (Barcelona) fails to produce a decent enough free kick for a player of his ability and the only target that he finds is the wall of defenders in front of him.
45' Carlos Martin (Alaves) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
45' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Jose Munuera blows for a foul.
43' Pedri (Barcelona) sets himself up and has a crack at goal from the edge of the box. The shot heads low to the middle of the goal, but Jesus Owono tracks it all the way and makes an easy save.
42' Jose Munuera blows for a foul after Santiago Mourino (Alaves) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
38' Rough tackle by Carlos Martin (Alaves). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
36' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
34' What was Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
33' Jose Munuera blows his whistle. Manu Sanchez (Alaves) commits a foul after dangerous play.
30' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) smashes a shot at goal from the edge of the area that drifts harmlessly past the right post.
28' Kike Garcia (Alaves) commits a rough foul. Jose Munuera stops the game and makes a call.
28' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) is flagged for offside.
25' The game is interrupted as Jon Guridi (Alaves) is flagged offside.
23' Carlos Martin (Alaves) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
22' Jon Guridi (Alaves) brings his opponent down. Jose Munuera has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
20' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
19' Jon Guridi (Alaves) is adjudged offside.
18' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
18' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
16' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Jose Munuera signals.
15' Jon Guridi (Alaves) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
14' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Tomas Conechny leaves the pitch to be replaced by Carlos Martin (Alaves).
14' Gavi is substituted due to injury. Hansi Flick gives a chance to Fermin Lopez (Barcelona).
9' Tomas Conechny (Alaves) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
9' Gavi (Barcelona) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
7' Gavi (Barcelona) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
5' Raphinha (Barcelona) receives a reproachful look from Lamine Yamal. He latches on to his pass, but the effort from the edge of the box sails well wide of the right post.
4' Jose Munuera blows his whistle as Antonio Blanco (Alaves) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
2' Tomas Conechny (Alaves) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Barcelona will have the kick-off.
Jose Munuera is introduced as the referee for today's match.
